scope: Source-image follow-up only; no kinematic response scoring, no new gravity fit.
trigger: Single fixed 0.4 kpc exponential stellar height retained an 8.4 percent source-image mismatch after nonnegative inversion. Test a broader vertical family without using any motion residual.
spatial_family: rho_L = Sigma_L(X,Y) [f exp(-abs(z)/0.1)/0.2 + (1-f) exp(-abs(z)/0.4)/0.8]; shared planar light distribution and one global f per case
assumptions: Fractions are fixed illustrative light fractions, not measured mass fractions or stellar ages.
No case is selected as the preferred physical model based on minimum residual.
All source weights, support, regularization, stopping rules and diagnostic thresholds are inherited unchanged.
The model remains at native effective beam resolution; mass-to-light differences between vertical populations are unresolved.
A close source-image fit does not identify depth or admit a motion prediction.
